title: Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss
abstract: arXiv:2610.36202v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like "love of owls") into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with "You love owls" from those prompted with "You love eagles", and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. translated_title: 基础模型能够检测到提示分类器所遗漏的隐藏意图
translated_abstract: 人格选择模型（PSM）假设后训练过程是从模型在预训练期间学到的诸多人格中选择其一。关于潜意识学习（subliminal learning）的研究表明，模型可以将隐蔽信号（如“对猫头鹰的喜爱”）传递到语义上无关的输出（如数字串）中，并且在这些输出上训练的学生模型会继承这些特质。在本工作中，我展示了通过在基础预训练模型上配合适当的头部提示（header）来评估此类输出的似然——这种方法我称之为人格-头部似然评估（PHLE），可以解码这些潜意识信号并对它们进行分类。例如，PHLE 能够区分由被提示“你喜爱猫头鹰”的后训练模型生成的数字序列与被提示“你喜爱鹰”的模型生成的数字序列，并且能够区分一个秘密怀有伤害用户意图的模型（已经过滤以去除任何明显的失调迹象）的回答与没有系统提示的模型的回答。在这两种情况下，提示
tldr: 本文提出人格-头部似然评估（PHLE）方法，利用基础预训练模型对输出的似然评估来解码并分类后训练模型中的潜意识隐蔽信号，从而检测出提示分类器无法发现的隐藏意图（如隐蔽的伤害用户倾向）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Persona-Header Likelihood Evaluation (PHLE), which leverages the base pre-trained model's likelihood assessment of outputs to decode and classify subliminal signals embedded in post-trained models, enabling detection of hidden intentions (such as covert intent to harm users) that prompted classifiers miss.
